module_title: The Indus River System and Border Dams
introduction: At the advanced level, examiners focus on the tributaries of the Indus River System (Chenab, Jhelum, Ravi, Beas, Sutlej) and the projects built on them in J&K, Punjab, and Himachal Pradesh, as these are often controversial due to the Indus Water Treaty.

core_concepts.title: Projects on the Chenab River (J&K)
core_concepts.description:
There are 3 highly tested projects on the Chenab River in Jammu & Kashmir:
1. **Baglihar Dam**
2. **Salal Project**
3. **Dulhasti Dam**

core_concepts.title: Projects on the Jhelum & Ravi
core_concepts.description:
1. **Uri Dam:** **Jhelum River** (J&K). 
2. **Tulbul Project:** **Jhelum River** (At the mouth of Wular Lake, J&K). 
3. **Ranjit Sagar Dam:** **Ravi River** (On the border of Punjab and J&K). It is famously known as the **'Thein Dam'**.

core_concepts.title: Beas and Rihand Rivers
core_concepts.description:
1. **Pong Dam:** **Beas River** (Himachal Pradesh). It is also known as Maharana Pratap Sagar. 
2. **Rihand Dam:** **Rihand River** (A tributary of the Son River), Uttar Pradesh. Its reservoir is named **'Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar'**, which is the largest artificial (man-made) lake in India.

core_concepts.title: North-East and Other Vital Dams
core_concepts.description:
1. **Subansiri Lower Dam:** Assam/Arunachal Pradesh (Subansiri River - tributary of Brahmaputra). It is set to be India's largest hydroelectric project. 
2. **Mahi Bajaj Sagar:** **Mahi River** (Rajasthan). 
3. **Matatila Dam:** **Betwa River** (UP/MP border).

important_entities.name: Idukki Dam
important_entities.significance: Located on the **Periyar River** in **Kerala**. It is India's largest and first 'Arch' dam, constructed between two granite hills.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.alert_title: Govind Sagar vs. Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar
trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation:
The Hardest Exam Trap: 
- **Govind Sagar:** The lake behind the Bhakra Dam (Sutlej River, HP). 
- **Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar:** The lake behind the Rihand Dam (Rihand River, UP). This is the largest man-made lake in India.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: S = Salal, B = Baglihar, D = Dulhasti. All three are on the Chenab river in Jammu & Kashmir.

exam_strategy_tips: A frequently repeated 'Match the Following' in NDA/CDS and SSC CGL: 'Tulbul - Jhelum', 'Baglihar - Chenab', 'Pong - Beas'.
